main_body: Thatched-roof hut: a large gold thatch roof slope (rows ~5-50) over a dark log-plank wall (rows ~51-78) with a recessed central doorway and two round shields
top_band: Gold thatch roof slope, rows ~5-50. It is lightest at the upper left and carries banded rows with dark ridge lines, ending in a lighter eave edge around rows 48-53.
evidence: Column through the middle: a thatch roof slope with a ridge cap at the top, a lighter eave edge near rows 48-53, a dark shadow under the eave, then the vertical log wall down to a stone base at rows 76-78. The roof reads as a sloped surface seen from above, like the reference houses. The door has a timber frame with a dark inner opening and a stone threshold, so it is inset. No receding side faces.

style.evidence: The thatch has about 5 tones (highlight, light, mid, dark brown row lines, deep edge) plus tick marks along each row. The wall has several brown plank tones with grain, and the stone base and shield details add variation. Outlines are dark brown and yellow-brown, not black. The thatch rows are fairly regular and a little repetitive next to the scalloped tiles and speckled plaster of the references, but there are no large flat areas and it would sit acceptably next to them.
